action.name: 粘贴为链接
action.command: sh -c 'd="%f"; [ -d "$d" ] || d="$(dirname "$d")"; wl-paste -t text/uri-list | while read -r line; do src=$(echo "$line" | sed "s|^file://||" | python3 -c "import sys, urllib.parse; print(urllib.parse.unquote(sys.stdin.read().strip()))"); [ -z "$src" ] && continue; name=$(basename "$src"); target="$d/$name"; if [ "$src" = "$target" ]; then target="$d/${name}_link"; fi; [ -e "$src" ] && ln -s "$src" "$target"; done'

action.name: 粘贴剪贴板图片
action.command: sh -c 'd="%f"; [ -d "$d" ] || d="$(dirname "$d")"; cd "$d" && wl-paste --list-types | grep -q "^image/" && wl-paste --type image/png > "img_$(date -Iseconds | cut -d+ -f1 | tr T _ | tr : -).png"'

action.name: 图片转png
action.command: bash -c 'exec 1>>/tmp/img_err.log 2>&1; /usr/bin/notify-send "图片转换" "正在后台处理 $# 张图片..."; for f in "$@"; do /usr/bin/magick "$f" -delete 1--1 "$(echo "$f" | sed "s/\.[^.]*$//").png"; done; /usr/bin/notify-send "图片转换" "处理完成"' -- %F

action.name: 压缩视频大小
action.command: kitty --class "floating-term" bash -c 'f="$1"; out="$(echo "$f" | sed "s/\.[^.]*$//")_compressed.mp4"; echo "正在处理: $f"; ffmpeg -i "$f" -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 128k -pix_fmt yuv420p "$out"; echo -e "\n✅ 压缩完成！文件已保存为: $out"; read -n 1 -s -r -p "按任意键退出..." ' -- %f
